title: Figure 13: Tic Tac parametric accelerations vs. event duration (ft/sec²)
description: Log-scale scatter plot titled "Tic Tac Parametric Accelerations for Selected Times of Event Duration (Points are Not Continuous)" with acceleration (ft/second², 1 to 1,000,000) against time (seconds, 0 to 10). Accelerations peak above 200,000 ft/s² at 0.5 s and decline to around 600 ft/s² at 10 s. The caption reads "Figure 13. Tic Tac Parametric Accelerations for Selected Times of Event Duration in ft/sec²" (BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report, page 37).
